dct_description_sm: Fundamental research in population ecology and evolutionary ecology, including the effects of population density, population sex-age structure, predation, weather, personality, horn and body size and previous reproductive success.  Applied research on ungulate management, including the consequences of harvesting females and the selective effects of trophy hunting for males.  See http://marco.recherche.usherbrooke.ca/all.htm for a list of publications.
dct_title_s: Ecology, management and evolution of bighorn sheep, Ram Mountain, Alberta
